core_obligations: Write the uniformizer of the smaller ring as a unit times a power of a uniformizer of the localization, with the exponent the ramification index, and set up the three reductions of the proof (proof lines 34050-34053).

Claim that the unit may be assumed to be an e-th power: adjoin a root of its defining equation, check the extension is finite separable by the hypothesis on e and the residue characteristic, and verify that the localizations become finite etale extensions on both sides (proof lines 34054-34076).

Use the resulting comparison diagram and the equivalence for extensions of discrete valuation rings to reduce the statement to the formally smoothness of the corresponding vertical map after adjoining the root (proof lines 34077-34079).

Assume the unit has an e-th root in the larger field, use divisibility of the ramification index and the root to write the uniformizer of the smaller ring as an e-th power of an element, and let A'_1 be the integral closure in the generated subfield, which is a discrete valuation ring of ramification index e (proof lines 34080-34095).

Transfer the conclusion from the subextension back to the original one by the going up statement, reducing to the case where the larger field is generated by the e-th root of the uniformizer (proof lines 34096-34102).

In that final case write the uniformizer of the larger ring as a unit times an e-th power, observe that adjoining the quotient of the roots makes the extension finite etale, read off ramification index one from multiplicativity and separability of the residue field from the tower of residue fields, and conclude by the criterion for formal smoothness (proof lines 34103-34135).
proof_roadmap: Set up the uniformizers and the ramification index, then reduce to the case where the unit is an e-th power (proof lines 34050-34079).
Reduce further to the subfield generated by the e-th root of the uniformizer, using the intermediate discrete valuation ring and going up (proof lines 34080-34102).
Final case: show the extension is finite etale, compute ramification index one and a separable residue field extension, and apply the criterion (proof lines 34103-34135).
difficulty_reason: Abhyankar 引理，statement 需要 Remark 引入的记号（K_1/K、A_1 与 B_1 的局部化、极大理想 m_i、m_ij），证明三层归约、每层都做实：先附加 u 的 e 次根把 u 假设成 e 次幂（要检验有限可分、局部化有限 étale）；再把 K_1 换成由 π 的 e 次根生成的子域并证明可借「形式光滑可上推」把结论传回；最后一段真正做计算——把 π_B 写成单位乘 e 次幂，说明附加两根之商使扩张有限 étale，再用分歧指数的乘性与剩余域的塔算出指数为 1 且剩余域扩张可分，用判别法收尾。5 处引用全在同章（含 statement 引用 Remark 与最后一句复用判别法），承重演算均在 span 内。
